description:
WEB DEVELOPER 
 
Why join Aptiv? You'll have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge applications, develop breakthrough technologies, and deliver innovative solutions to some of the world’s leading automotive brands. See your work come to life on the road—helping make mobility safer, greener, and more connected. Ready to shape the future of mobility with us?
 
 
 YOUR ROLE 
 As a Web Developer, you will play a key role in strengthening our internal capabilities for maintaining and developing our enterprise web platforms. Working across Sitefinity CMS and modern .NET technologies, you will collaborate closely with Global Marketing, IT, and internal stakeholders to build scalable solutions, enhance system integrations, and drive continuous improvement across our web ecosystem. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to backend architecture, content build and maintenance, establish development standards, and grow technical depth within a collaborative team environment.
 
 Your role:
 Develop and maintain websites based on the Sitefinity CMS, ensuring high performance, Accessibility (WCAG 2.1–2.2), security, and SEO/SEM optimization
 Contribute to building scalable solutions with a strong focus on performance and maintainability
 Maintain integrations with external systems using REST APIs
 Troubleshoot issues, implement fixes, and optimize system performance
 Collaborate with designers, content teams, and internal clients to deliver tailored web solutions
 Actively monitor and act on SEO and accessibility reports to drive continuous improvements in site performance, organic traffic, and visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines
 Work with tools such as Hawksearch and Applitools to support continuous improvement of site search performance and automated page testing
 Partner with external agencies to ensure the timely delivery and quality of joint projects
 Collaborate with technical teams on web infrastructure and DevOps processes (CI/CD, CDN, SSL, backups)
 Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing to support team growth and learning
 Stay up to date with evolving web technologies, UX best practices, and security/compliance standards, and proactively introduce improvements
 Your background:
 3+ years of professional web development experience, preferably in enterprise environments
 Experience in working with CMS platforms (Sitefinity preferred)
 Experience in working with platforms like: Hawksearch, Applitools, SEMRush
 Strong hands-on experience with frontend technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and familiarity with modern frameworks (e.g., Angular, React)
 Knowledge of C# and .NET / ASP.NET technologies
 Experience integrating web applications with external systems using REST APIs
 Understanding of web best practices including information architecture, responsive design, content modeling, and metadata/tagging
 Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and contribute to continuous platform improvements
 Strong collaboration and communication skills
 Excellent command of English
 
 
 WHY JOIN US? 
 You can grow at Aptiv. Aptiv provides an inclusive work environment where all individuals can grow and develop, regardless of gender, ethnicity or beliefs.
 You can have an impact . Safety is a core Aptiv value; we want a safer world for us and our children, one with: Zero fatalities, Zero injuries, Zero accidents.
 You have support . We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family and your physical and mental health with a competitive health insurance package.
 
 
 YOUR BENEFITS AT APTIV: 
 Savings Fund
 Pension Plan
 Christmas Bonus
 Attendance Bonus
 Vacation Premium
 Medical Expenses
 Life Insurance
 Social security (IMSS, INFONAVIT, Retirement)
 Recognition for innovation and excellence
 Opportunities to give back to the community
 
 APPLY TODAY, AND TOGETHER LET’S CHANGE TOMORROW!  
 
 “Aptiv is an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law”
